skill_name: Create one example for an approach to query a review for a product.
workflow: An example approach to query a review for a product such as an air purifier would be to ask what key features of the air purifier the customer liked or disliked. Questions such as “was the air purifier easy to install?”, “was the air purifier's filter efficient?” and “was the air purifier quiet?” can be asked to get an idea of what the customer experienced with the product. Additionally, pros and cons of the product can be asked, to get a detailed overview of the review.
